caption: The drawing consists of blue pencil or ink illustrations on a light tan or beige background. The composition is densely filled with intertwined branches featuring large leaves, clusters of flowers, and numerous round fruits that resemble pomegranates. Perched on the branches are two peacocks, drawn in profile, with long tails and crests on their heads, one near the center of the composition and the other closer to the lower edge. The branches diagonally cross the image from corner to corner. Various types of foliage fill the negative spaces between the branches, fruits, and flowers, resulting in a continuous and repetitive decorative pattern. The entire image is rendered in shades of blue, without additional colors, except for the uniformly light tan background.
title: Bedspread
